record.name: Liftora: AI Life Coach
record.offering: Productivity app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Self-improvement is a system, not a motivation problem.

Stop relying on motivation. Build a system that helps you take action, stay accountable, and make consistent progress.

Liftora is an AI-powered self-improvement app designed to help you improve your habits, routines, productivity, focus, discipline, and personal development.

With an AI Coach, app blocker, routines, task planning, accountability tools, and AI-powered features, Liftora helps you turn your goals into consistent action.

AI Coach

Get personalized guidance for your goals, routines, productivity, and personal development.

Liftora's AI Coaches let you interact through text, voice, or video and provide personalized support based on your goals and challenges.

Whether you're struggling with procrastination, consistency, focus, productivity, or staying on track, your AI Coach can help you identify actionable steps and build better systems.

App Blocker

Your environment affects your behavior.

Liftora's app blocker helps reduce digital distractions and protect your focus by limiting access to distracting apps.

Create an environment that makes it easier to focus on your goals instead of constantly fighting distractions.

Build Better Routines

Create personalized routines and organize your day with planning tools designed to help you know what to do next.

Use Liftora's AI routine generator to create routines around your goals and build a more structured approach to your day.

Build Consistency

Track your progress with Liftora's No Zero Days system.

Complete something meaningful each day and keep your streak moving forward. The goal is not perfection. The goal is consistent action.

Stay Accountable

Set goals, complete tasks, check in, and track your progress.

Liftora is designed to help you build systems around your goals instead of depending on motivation to stay consistent.

Improve Your Life Systematically

Use Liftora to work on:

• Building better habits
• Developing discipline
• Improving productivity
• Creating daily routines
• Reducing procrastination
• Improving focus
• Managing goals
• Reducing screen time
• Staying accountable
• Personal development

A Different Approach to Self-Improvement

Motivation comes and goes.

A system can keep working.

Liftora focuses on the underlying systems that influence your behavior: your routines, environment, habits, accountability, and daily actions.

Build the system. Take action. Stay consistent. Build yourself.

Lift Your Limits. Live Your Best.

record.offering: Education app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Transform your accounting challenges into clear solutions with Accounting AI Solver. Whether you're a student, professional, or lifelong learner, our app acts like a personal accounting tutor, available whenever you need it.

Feeling overwhelmed with debits and credits? Accounting AI Solver helps you move from confusion to clarity. Instead of just providing answers, it guides you through each problem step by step, helping you understand fundamental concepts more deeply. Ask follow-up questions, learn at your own pace, and keep your study notes organized effortlessly.

Why students love Accounting AI Solver

Snap and solve in seconds
Take a photo or type in your accounting problem and receive a detailed step-by-step solution quickly.

Chat with your AI tutor
Engage with your virtual tutor to ask 'why,' 'how,' or 'what if' questions until the concept is crystal clear.

Turn solutions into flashcards
Convert solved problems into interactive flashcards to review key formulas, definitions, and methods.

Study smarter
Save time with explanations tailored to your level and learning pace, offering visual and easy-to-follow guidance.

Topics covered

From basic accounting principles and financial statements to complex topics like cost accounting, taxation, auditing, and managerial accounting, Accounting AI Solver adapts to your level and explains concepts in a way that feels approachable. Whether you're a beginner or advancing your skills, our app makes accounting topics more understandable.

Perfect for
- Students seeking a deeper understanding of accounting
- Professionals looking to enhance their skills
- Parents helping their children with homework
- Test prep for exams like CPA, CMA, and ACCA

We are always improving. Send feedback or ideas to support_accounting@gritapps.com.

Subscriptions renew automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current billing period.

You can manage or cancel your subscription anytime in Account Settings.

Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period.

Any unused portion of a free trial will be forfeited when you purchase a subscription.

record.description_evidence:
The reference app in the financial market, trusted by over 8 million customers. Manage your personal finances, bank accounts, cards, savings, and investments quickly, easily, and 100% securely.

MORE SPEED AND PERSONALIZATION
We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to optimize every banking operation. Make your online purchases or routine bank transfers with a single click. Plus, forget about searching for the same contact to send a Bizum; the app automatically organizes your favorite operations, payments, and financial products directly on the home menu so you don't waste time.

WHAT'S NEW AND FEATURED SERVICES AT BBVA

AQUA CARDS WITH AI AND COMMISSION-FREE PURCHASES ABROAD
Your Aqua Card is a pioneer in banking security: no printed numbers and a dynamic CVV that changes with every online purchase. Now it goes a step further:
• Unique design generated with AI: Personalize your Aqua Debit or Credit Card with exclusive images created by Artificial Intelligence.
• Travel abroad without commissions: With the Travel Pack, pay at merchants worldwide in another currency (dollars, pounds...) without currency exchange fees (up to €300/month free on the Essential Plan). Plus, withdraw cash at international ATMs. If you are under 30, the Superior Pack is included!
• Digital turn off and on: If you lose it, turn it off and on instantly from the app.

FAST TRACK MORTGAGE: YOUR AMOUNT IN LESS THAN 8 HOURS
Forget about simple mortgage simulators. With the Fast Track service, find out the real viability and exact amount to finance your future home.
• No paperwork or waiting: Connect your official data in a 100% secure way (Tax Agency and Social Security) via Cl@ve Móvil.
• In less than 8 business hours, you will get your personalized proposal with no obligation and without being a prior customer.

YOUR FINANCIAL COACH AND EXPENSE CONTROL
We help you improve your financial health with an automatic diagnosis of your monthly savings capacity.
• AI analyzes your income and expenses to offer you a personalized plan.
• Detect subscriptions and small recurring expenses, build an emergency financial cushion, and track the evolution of your money month by month.

ALL FINANCIAL TOOLS AT YOUR FINGERTIPS

• Bank Accounts and Bizum: Open your Fee-Free Online Account in 10 minutes. Pay or request money via Bizum instantly. Also available for minors (Kids' Online Account with adapted app and Bizum from age 12).
• Financial Health and Bank Aggregation: Connect your other banks to see all your accounts, cards, and loans on a single screen.
• Smart Discrete Mode: Automatically hide balances and transactions in public places to protect your privacy.
• Blue Virtual Assistant: Resolve doubts 24/7 about transfers, bills, and operations with our AI chatbot.
• Personal Loans: Simulate your monthly installment and apply for your personal loan 100% online.
• Insurance: Apply for and manage your car, home, life, or health insurance directly from the app.
• Investments, Funds, and Stock Market: Invest in the stock market, investment funds tailored to your profile, and trade with BBVA Trader. If you have negative returns on your funds in your first year, BBVA refunds you up to €300.
• Pension Plans: Plan your retirement with periodic contributions and fee-free transfers.
• Freelancers and Businesses: Invoicing management, mobile POS collection, and financing for your business.
• BBVA Friend Plan: Invite your friends to open an online account and earn money.

Additionally, the app is compatible with smartwatches and Wear OS.

SUPPORT AND CUSTOMER SERVICE
Do you have any questions or suggestions about the app?
Write to us at bbvabancamovil@bbva.com

If your terminal is not compatible, access your finances on BBVA Mobile Banking from bbva.es in your browser.

record.offering: Finance app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
THE UNIVERSAL BILLING PLATFORM FOR VENDORS, CUSTOMERS, CONTRACTORS, LANDLORDS, TENANTS, STORES, FRIENDS - ALL IN ONE PLACE!

BillBetter.AI keeps every bill in one place — recorded, reviewed, approved, and paid — for you and the people you share the books with.

    INVOICE, GET PAID, AND PAY IN ONE TAP
    
    VENDORS, ACCEPT CUSTOMER PAYMENTS IN MINUTES
    Send an invoice to a customer, watch it get paid, and see every payment in and out. Quick pay sends money to anyone — if they can't receive online payments yet, the payment waits and goes out the moment they connect a bank.

    PAY AND RECORD PAYMENTS
    Mark bills paid — including partial payments, with the remaining balance tracked — or pay online by card or bank transfer through a secure payment page. Payments are processed by Stripe; BillBetter.AI never holds your money.

    RECORD A BILL WITH YOUR CAMERA
    Point your phone at a paper bill or pick a photo from your library. AI reads the document and fills in who it's from, the amount, the due date, the description, and the line items. Check the fields, file it under the right company or folder, and it's recorded.

    SEE WHERE YOU STAND
    The dashboard shows what's waiting on your decision, what you owe, what you've paid, what you've billed, and what's been collected — plus a live feed of recent activity across your account.

    DECIDE FROM YOUR PHONE
    Open any bill to approve it, reject it with a note back to the biller, or move it back to pending. If your team uses sign-offs, you can give your approval right from the bill. Line items and the full history of who did what are on every bill.

    LANDLORDS, TENANTS, AND JOBS
    Property managers see units, tenants, rent status, work orders, and announcements. Tenants get their own portal: rent, lease, maintenance requests, and messages with the manager.

    SEND AND RECEIVE PROPOSALS ON THE PLATFORM
    Send and receive proposals — pitch a priced job to any customer, or collect sealed bids from contractors and vendors. One tap on an accepted proposal turns it into a live work order or purchase order, price approved and ready to invoice.

    ONE ACCOUNT, PHONE AND WEB
    Your account is the same on the web app at billbetter.ai, where the rest of the platform lives: email bill intake, linking banks and cards, reports, tax forms, and QuickBooks sync. Anything you do on your phone is instantly there too — and shared company folders keep teammates, partners, and bookkeepers on the same page.

    WHO IT'S FOR
    Small businesses, landlords and property managers, contractors, and anyone who splits bills with partners or a team.

    Creating an account is free. Card and bank payments carry a processing fee, shown before you pay.

Ignitte is private, on-device AI accounting for small businesses and solo operators.

Your books live on your phone, not on our servers. Every number is computed by code, not guessed by AI. The cloud holds only an encrypted backup it cannot read.

SPEAK OR SNAP, DON'T TYPE
• Voice entry — say "sold two coffees for 9 dollars" and it's posted
• Receipt scanning — point the camera, the amount and vendor are extracted on-device
• Ask Ignitte — "how much did I spend on fuel last month?" answered instantly, offline

REAL ACCOUNTING, NOT A SPREADSHEET
• Double-entry ledger with an append-only audit trail — corrections are reversed, never erased
• Profit & Loss, Balance Sheet and Cash Flow statements
• Safe-to-Spend — see what's actually yours after tax is set aside
• Tax rules for Australia (GST), UK (VAT), Nepal (VAT) and the US

RUN THE BUSINESS TOO
• Invoices as PDF, ready to send
• Stock, purchase orders and stocktakes
• Appointments
• CSV and PDF export — your data is always portable

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• All AI runs on-device — voice, receipts, questions. Nothing is uploaded to be processed.
• Cloud backup is end-to-end encrypted (AES-256). We cannot read it. Nobody can.
• The key stays in your iCloud Keychain, so a new phone restores your books automatically.
• No account required to start.

• Lock screen and home screen widgets

Built for cafés, tradies, freelancers, market stalls and anyone who runs their own thing and wants their numbers to be right and private.

record.description_evidence:
Sable is an AI agent, on a dedicated computer, running 24/7, connected to your apps, working constantly on your behalf.

It's a real computer. Always on, always working, even when you're not looking. 

You give it objectives, not instructions, and it figures out how to get them done.

Sable is an agentic AI that works, not one that just talks. Real actions, taken for you, on your own computer.

You know that feeling where you're managing everything yourself? Your inbox, your schedule, your finances, your family. 

All of it, all the time, all you. You go to bed thinking about what you forgot. You wake up already behind.

Sable is the end of that.

Imagine waking up and the work is done. Not because you stayed up late. Because your computer never went to sleep. It was handling things while you were living your life. Following up on the things you forgot. 

Organizing what you didn't have time for. Keeping everything moving.

And on your computer, there's a team.

Not bots. Not chatbots. People. Each one has memory, personality, and expertise. Each one is dedicated to only you. And they don't just respond when you talk to them. 

They notice things. They remember things. They care.

Your bookkeeper catches something in your spending before you even notice. Your life coach nudges you about the thing you said you'd do this week. Your organizer already sorted tomorrow because they know how you like your mornings.

They don't wait for instructions. They pay attention. They reach out when it's been too long. They say the thing you need to hear, not the thing that's safe. They know you. Not your profile. You.

You choose who's on your team. Create anyone, for any part of your life. A work assistant. A bookkeeper. A daily organizer. A life coach. Or anyone you can think of.

This is the kind of help that used to be reserved for people with money. A personal staff. People who handle things. People who know you.

Your computer is connected to your real apps and accounts. It doesn't just talk about doing things. It does them. It acts on your behalf, across everything you use. Every action is logged. 

Every decision is transparent. You're always in control.

One continuous conversation that never resets. 

It learns how you work, what you care about, how you think. Ask about something from weeks ago. 

It knows exactly what you're talking about. Nothing is forgotten. Nothing is lost.

Someone gave their life access to this computer. Their messages, their calendar, their files. That's not a feature. That's trust. And Sable treats it that way. 

Private things stay private. Always.

It never sleeps.

From any device, anywhere.

--

Full access to features is available with an active subscription.

Tap once, talk, done. Kosha listens while you debrief after a visit — no forms, no typing in the parking lot. Add a photo of the shelf or a menu, or type a quick note when talking isn't an option.
